title: cyclosorus excrescens
intro: Cyclosorus excrescens, commonly known as the Iron Sword Fern, is a species of fern native to tropical regions of Asia. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine, providing various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to alleviate conditions like arthritis and cancer. The therapeutic actions of Cyclosorus excrescens include its ability to inhibit the growth of certain bacteria and fungi, as well as its potential to lower blood sugar levels. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
